title: Unmarked black helicopters arrive at Ellsworth
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: it over the next few weeks suddenly we had an influx of black shoy helicopters completely unmarked

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels, in an episode with a researcher named Robert Hastings about UFOs over nuclear bases, passes on what someone told him about Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota in the 1960s. According to that account, over a few weeks a wave of shiny black helicopters with no markings at all suddenly showed up at the base. The story is told as a sign that some unexplained event there drew a quiet, secret response.
